title: cmd_gc_run (cli/ops): deletes from pinned_cids only — does not unpin from IPFS or delete articles row
description: cli/ops.rs cmd_gc_run(): when policy.should_pin() returns false, only DELETE FROM pinned_cids is executed. No call to PinClient::unpin() and no DELETE FROM articles. The CID remains pinned in IPFS and the articles row remains, so GC achieves no actual space reclamation. The operator who runs 'transit gc-run' expects the blocks to be actually freed. This parallels the GcRunner/GcExecutor split found in retention/gc.rs — a second instance of the same pattern where the DB-cleanup half is missing.
